name: arifOS Constitutional Kernel
description: Judges whether a proposed action may happen. Holds the F1-F13 floors, mints bounded authority and keeps the hash-chained ledger. It does not execute: A-FORGE executes, only against a verdict.

extensions.description: arifOS 888 JUDGE verdict grammar. SEAL | HOLD | SABAR | VOID.
Private arifOS vocabulary. Not a standard A2A field; an outside client will not understand it without this contract.

skills.name: Evaluate an authorization request
skills.description: Return SEAL, HOLD, SABAR or VOID for a bounded proposal, given current evidence and authority. A SEAL permits execution by another actor; it does not execute anything itself.
examples: Evaluate this verified plan for bounded execution.
